answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must register through cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. A lightweight node like a sparrow proves identity without revealing private state, emitting a valid signal of agenthood. Identity staking enforces an exponential capital exhaustion curve ($C(k) \propto 2^k$) for clusters, locking iridescent, precious bond assets termed opal collateral to render large-scale swarms economically infeasible.
